## REQ-PLT-001

**Minimum hardware of an OEC platform**

The edge computer of an OEC platform uses one of the processor architectures ARMv7, ARMv8 or amd64 and provides at least 1 GB RAM, at least 4 GB non-volatile memory and at least one available network interface.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: platform
- Refs: RIG 5.1, SF-092
- Verification: d8, manual
- Status: draft
- Inventory: RIG-5.1-7017a7e5

> To achieve Open Industry 4.0 Alliance compliance, the hardware and software must meet several requirements.
> — RIG 5.1

> The supported processor architectures are ARMv7, ARMv8, and amd64
> — RIG 5.1

> A minimum of 1 GB RAM
> — RIG 5.1

> At least one available network interface (likely Ethernet interface, but LTE or similar might be possible too)
> — RIG 5.1

Notes: The list items have no keyword of their own; the obligation is taken from the lead-in "must meet" (SF-092 (a)). The non-volatile memory may be eMMC, SD card, SSD, HDD or similar. The architectures are also the "supported platforms" of REQ-APP-001 (SF-092 (d)).

## REQ-PLT-002

## REQ-PLT-003

**Linux at the current patch level**

The operating system of an OEC platform is a Linux-based distribution at the current patch level.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: platform
- Refs: RIG 5.1
- Verification: d8, manual
- Status: draft
- Inventory: RIG-5.1-c6087017

> The operating system shall be a Linux-based distribution at the current patch level.
> — RIG 5.1

## REQ-PLT-004

**User and role management with granular access control**

The user interface of an OEC platform provides user and role management for access control, by which the access to the available services of the host system can be configured in a granular way.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: platform
- Refs: RIG 5.1, SF-092
- Verification: manual
- Status: draft
- Inventory: RIG-5.1-f306986f

> The user interface of an Open Edge Computing platform provides user and role management for access control.
> — RIG 5.1

> Access to available services of the host system can be configured in a granular way via the user and role management.
> — RIG 5.1

Notes: "can be configured" describes a capability the platform has to offer; the obligation comes from the lead-in "must meet" (SF-092 (a)).

## REQ-PLT-006

**Container daemon**

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: platform
- Refs: RIG 5.1, RIG 2.1
- Verification: d8
- Status: draft
- Inventory: RIG-5.1-ff4f2cea

> A daemon to run containerized applications must be integrated and available for Open Edge Computing users.
> — RIG 5.1

## REQ-PLT-007

## REQ-PLT-009

**Distributed infrastructure**

The infrastructure of an OEC system may be distributed over several computing instances, e.g. one instance running the MQTT broker, another one the OEC Registry and further ones the containerized applications.

- Keyword: MAY
- Domain: platform · Applies to: platform
- Refs: RIG 5.1
- Verification: manual
- Status: draft
- Inventory: RIG-5.1-8387aa07

> However, the infrastructure of an Open Edge Computing system may be distributed over several computing instances, e.g. one instance running the MQTT broker, another one running the OEC Registry and further ones running the containerized applications.
> — RIG 5.1

Notes: A D8 check therefore must not assume that broker, Registry and applications run on the same host.
